rv.q: Hamlet Hail to the Thief works as a lucid, angsty revenge tragedy, played with clarity and verve.
Technically spectacular, Radiohead’s 2003 concept album in conversation with Shakespeare is an innovation in form
Hamlet Hail to the Thief is incredibly powerful and hits like a train.
It's all delivered in a style that makes you feel like you're bingeing on an unmissable new Netflix drama, rather than watching a classic Shakespeare fable unfold.
